contorion-series-b.title: Online Industrial Retailer Contorion Raises Substantial Investment to Accelerate Expansion
contorion-series-b.text: Oct 19, 2016 Portfolio press Online Industrial Retailer Contorion Raises Substantial Investment to Accelerate Expansion Share this post on Twitter , Facebook or Google+ Investment affirms Contorion's’ position as the innovative digital player in the German Online Maintenance, Repair & Operations market Berlin, 19 October 2016 – Contorion, the eCommerce player for trade and industrial supply has announced today that it has secured substantial investment from major new investors. The dutch investment fund Endeit Capital invested in Contorion. This completes the Series-B financing round after the investment of kloeckner.v, the investment vehicle of Klöckner & Co SE, and existing investors Project A Ventures and Bauer Venture Partners in July 2016. In total, Contorion received a double digit million Euro funding in this Series-B round. Contorion offers an online platform to sell maintenance, repair & operations ("MRO") products to small and midsized manufacturing businesses and craftsmen. The assortment includes more than 300.000 industrial products in different categories, e.g. power & hand tools, work safety, fasteners and workshop equipment. The company is serving more than 150.000 customers in Germany and Austria and is employing about 100 team members. The new funding will allow Contorion to further bring innovation into the traditional MRO market. It will help fund the continued expansion of Contorion into new product groups with its A-brand partners. Scaling of domestic sales and marketing activities is part of that strategy. The funding will also be used to enhance the company's customer segmentation and data analytics capabilities, as well as the development of proprietary customer offers and other innovations to further facilitate client needs. Tobias Tschötsch, Managing Director and co-founder of Contorion GmbH, commented: “We firmly believe that online ordering, data collection and dynamically servicing of MRO products to our clients is the future of B2B supply and we’re delighted to have received significant funding to support our expansion. The investment recognises the unique and independent value of Contorion’s position in Germany.” Since the launch in August 2014, Contorion has grown rapidly to become one of the largest and innovative online MRO players in Germany, operating a user friendly, high-growth business with over 60 key MRO brands like Festool, Makita, Knipex, Hazet, Wera. Recently, Contorion opened its first retail shop in Berlin facilitating specialised promotions of key leading tool brands to professional clients. Contorion has more than doubled in revenue year on year, already reporting significant double digit million Euro in net revenue for 2016. With the global 2015 MRO spend being worth €450 billion, of which about €30 billion in Germany, there is a compelling growth opportunity here to grow this traditional MRO servicing model into an online platform. The current online share is less than 5% and is expected to increase to 25% in the coming years. Such shift will improve transparency, data analysis and user friendliness of search and ordering. As the industrial world becomes more connected technologically, customers want real-time access to information, ordering and just-in-time delivery of products. Christoph Neuhaus, Managing Director of Endeit Advisors, said: “Contorion allows craftsmen and industrial companies to fully concentrate on their business. By the use of innovative data technology and best-in class service for B2B customers, Contorion replaces existing purchasing processes, e.g. via catalogs, sales agents or retails shops – everything is delivered with one click. With this offering, Contorion was able to grow strongly and gained an innovative leadership position in the German B2B eCommerce market. We’re proud to support the innovative and entrepreneurial founder team and we’re excited to be working with Contorion as the company enters the next phase of its development.” Download press release

release-3.title: Wine in Black Receives Funding from Black River Ventures
release-3.text: May 19, 2015 Portfolio Wine in Black Receives Funding from Black River Ventures Share this post on Twitter , Facebook or Google+ Online shop has secured 10 million euro in financing during the past 12 months New funding by Black River Ventures will support expansion across Europe Berlin, May 19, 2015 – Wine in Black , the leading online shop for premium wine has closed a new financing round. Black River Ventures joins as a new investor, with existing investors including Project A Ventures, b-to-v, e.ventures, and Passion Capital also participated in the round. The new funds will be invested into personalizing the user experience, product expansion, growing their customer base and entering new markets. In addition, Wine in Black intends to further recruit experienced experts. In the first quarter of 2015, Wine in Black passed the threshold of 500,000 registered members, and over the past 12 months the company has raised 10 million euro in venture capital funding. The Wine in Black founders Stephan Linden and Christian Hoya “We are very happy to have Black River Ventures joining as a strong partner to further our growth, extend our assortment of premium wines, and continue to improve the shopping experience for our customers”, states Christian Hoya, co-founder and managing director of Wine in Black. “Moreover, we truly appreciate the trust of our existing investors who participated once again in this round”, adds his colleague Stephan Linden. “The combination of curated premium wines and high quality content addresses a growing target group out of which Wine in Black is generating its impressive and loyal customer base”, states Andrey Daleky, Partner of Black River Ventures. “We want to support Wine in Black with our investment in becoming the leading European player in its segment.” “Wine in Black is a good example of how e-commerce business models can evolve with innovative approaches and excellent execution in verticals which have already been existing for a while”, says Florian Heinemann, co-founder and managing director of Project A Ventures. “We invested and supported the company at a very early stage. We are very happy to see its sustainable development and are convinced that Wine in Black will continue growing strongly in future.” Wine in Black is an exclusive online shop for premium wine with customers between 30 and 45 years old who love to discover new wines every day. The wine experts of Wine in Black select a few particularly interesting wines out of hundreds every month and present them with detailed information in the online shop as well as in the Wine in Black wine guide The European wine market amounts to more than 60 billion euro, with the German market accounting for 9 billion euro. The premium segment starts at 7 euro per bottle and represents about half of the market. The online share in the wine industry is in the low one-digit percentage range but grows strongly as does the overall online market for food, in which several other large investments have recently taken place. About Wine in Black Wine in Black offers a constantly changing assortment of well-chosen premium wines. Experienced wine experts select these wines with a focus on quality. In the company’s online shop, the wines are presented with additional information on their origin and quality. Wine in Black’s mission is to make wine shopping much easier and more individual, in particular for wine lovers with less knowledge about wine. More than 350.000 members regularly receive newest wine discoveries and offers by newsletter and social media. For more information visit www.wine-in-black.de/ . Press contact Wine in Black Mareike Terjung MAVENS GmbH Tel: +49 40 38 02 38 66 E-mail: m.terjung@mavens.de About Black River Ventures Black River Ventures is investing into innovative companies across the European technology space, primarily in the IT and Internet segments. Black River Ventures partners with early and growth stage visionary companies aiming to become industry leaders. Their mission is to provide smart capital for long-term growth by leveraging the collective experience and expertise of the BRV team based in the EU and US. For more information visit brv.vc. . About Project A Ventures Project A Ventures is a company builder focusing on transactional and innovative business models in the Internet space as well as on Adtech. With a 80 million Euros fund and the sound operational know-how of our 100 experts, we help start-ups to build up competences in key areas such as IT, Performance Marketing, Business Intelligence and Organization Building, and thus contribute to their sustainable success. Our experts, based in Berlin and Sao Paulo, are among the best in their field and have been involved in building more than 50 market leading companies worldwide within the last 15 years. new-partners.title: Project A Expands Management Team
new-partners.text: Sep 28, 2016 Project A news Project A Expands Management Team Share this post on Twitter , Facebook or Google+ Open Letter from our Founding Partners Dear all, Today we have one important announcement to make: We are very happy and excited that we have successfully completed our management team by bringing two new General Partners on board: Dr. Anton Waitz and Benjamin Fischer. In his previous role, Anton was Managing Director of Axel Springer Digital Ventures in Palo Alto and New York. We have known Anton for about 4 years and believe he will make an excellent addition to our team. In particular, with the experience he has gathered over the last 2.5 years, when he was involved in building the Axel Springer venture/digital investment business in the US and led several early stage investments during that time, Anton will enhance our investment competences and expand our US network. Ben was Group CFO of Quandoo where he built-up the central functions for Finance/Legal, Business Intelligence and HR and was a key member of the global management team. Prior to that he was a Partner at Bain & Company with a strong focus on helping Private Equity clients during commercial due diligence and post acquisition value creation. We have known Ben for 20 years – back from business school – and believe that he will complement our team perfectly. Ben will help us to broaden our management bandwidth in investment diligence, running our company builder operations, coaching our portfolio companies in growth stage, as well as supporting on the exit management and investors network/fundraising side. With Anton and Ben joining our management team, Christian Weiss will be stepping down as Managing Director and will switch to a non-operational/advisory role as Venture Partner. Thereby, we will ensure a smooth transition of responsibilities. We are very grateful for Christian’s contribution to starting and developing Project A over the last four and half years and look forward to continue working with him as a venture partner. Anton and Ben will take on their new roles on Oct. 1, 2016 and Dec. 1, 2016, respectively. Best regards, Thies, Uwe and Florian

press-release-of-onlineprinters-gmbh-and.title: Project A invests in Onlineprinters: Growth sector online printing
press-release-of-onlineprinters-gmbh-and.text: Nov 29, 2016 Portfolio press Project A invests in Onlineprinters: Growth sector online printing Share this post on Twitter , Facebook or Google+ E-commerce company wins another partner to promote growth and expansion Berlin/Neustadt an der Aisch – After Bregal Unternehmerkapital acquired the majority of Onlineprinters GmbH, the Berlin-based Project A Ventures has also invested in the printing company. The venture capital investor has invested a sum in the single-digit million range in Onlineprinters. Moreover, Dr. Florian Heinemann, the founder and manager of Project A, joins the company's advisory board. Being one of Europe's leading online print companies, Onlineprinters produced more than 2.1 billion printed products last year, from flyers to full-fledged exhibition stands. The company has delivered to 500,000 customers so far and employs a workforce of more than 600. Internationally, the e-commerce company operates under the brand name Onlineprinters in 30 countries; in Germany, it trades under the name diedruckerei.de. Project A Ventures is known as a venture capital company that boosts the success of its portfolio companies by contributing its own operative resources. Besides various early-stage investments, Project A has realised huge successes with investments in other market leaders in the industry. "Onlineprinters has shown impressive growth performance over the past years and is already established in dozens of international markets. By taking our experts on board, we can achieve further improvements in Performance Marketing, CRM, Business Intelligence and Internationalisation," says Dr. Florian Heinemann, the founder and manager of Project A. "We believe that this joint investment with an experienced private equity partner is the recipe for success of our operative VC approach." Onlineprinters' Founder Walter Meyer and CEO Michael Fries Dr. Michael Fries, CEO of Onlineprinters GmbH, on the new partner: "With Bregal Unternehmerkapital as a majority investor at our side, we can rely on a specialist for medium-sized business excellence. We are pleased to additionally welcome the e-commerce experts of Project A as our partner. We have thus set the course for dynamic growth and further strengthening our position as a leader in the European online printing industry." About Project A Project A is a Berlin-based investor and operative VC in digital technologies. By providing financing and operative expertise, Project A supports companies in building their own competencies in core functional areas with their team of specialists in the areas of IT & Product, Marketing & CRM, Business Intelligence and Organisation Building. In the past years, Project A has actively contributed to building successful companies such as kfzteile24.de, Catawiki, Contorion, Eyeota, Lostmy.name, Nu3, Spryker, Tictail, WorldRemit and ZenMate. To learn more about Project A Ventures, see www.project-a.com or the blog insights.project-a.com Download Press Release Download image print Download image Walter Meyer & Michael Fries About Onlineprinters Onlineprinters GmbH is one of Europe's leading online print providers. In line with the motto "Print simply online!" the company sells printed products to 500,000 customers in 30 European countries through its 15 web shops. Internationally, the company is known under the brand name "Onlineprinters"; in Germany it operates under the name "diedruckerei.de". The product range comprises 1,400 printed products from business cards, stationery and flyers to catalogues, brochures and large-format advertising systems. The formula to successfully produce customised prints in terms of Industry 4.0 rests on three pillars: online sales, fully integrated production from ordering to shipping and gang run printing. The latter uses so-called combined forms to collectively produce print jobs, therefore minimising costs and reducing the environmental impact. Selected products allow customers to choose the option of same day printing (produced on the same working day), overnight delivery, climate neutral production and custom size specification. Onlineprinters GmbH employs a staff of 600 and produces over two billion printings per year. About Bregal Unternehmerkapital Bregal Unternehmerkapital is part of a family-owned business that has been built up over generations. Its investment activity is free of institutional constraints, based on long-term commitment and independent of developments in the financial markets. Bregal Unternehmerkapital identifies companies with strong management teams that are regarded as market leaders or “hidden champions” in their particular segment. Flexible financing and transaction structures enable it to acquire both minority and majority stakes. In doing so, Bregal Unternehmerkapital is also able to handle complex industry spin-offs, management buy-outs and succession situations in a sensitive, non-dogmatic manner. Bregal Unternehmerkapital aims to help companies achieve a sustained improvement in sales and profitability, and provides them with capital, proven financial expertise and access to a broad network of entrepreneurs and industry experts.
